services.title: Bridal Makeover
services.description: Exquisite, transfer-proof bridal looks engineered to last from your morning rituals through the final dance. We sculpt light itself onto your face using HD airbrush and luxury products.
services.whatsapp: Hi Glow %26 Glam! I'd like to inquire about Bridal Makeover for my wedding date.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: We recommend booking 3–6 months in advance for bridal, especially during peak wedding season (Oct–Feb). Popular dates fill very quickly.

faqs.q: Do you offer a trial session?
faqs.a: Yes — a bridal trial is strongly encouraged 4–6 weeks before your wedding. It's available à la carte.

faqs.q: Do you travel to the venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer on-location services. Travel fees may apply outside Chennai city limits.
We use luxury brands — MAC, Charlotte Tilbury, Armani Beauty, and Temptu airbrush system — chosen for longevity and skin compatibility.

reviews.name: Priya S.
reviews.text: I've never felt so beautiful. The team understood my vision perfectly — a luminous, natural-looking bridal look that lasted through tears, heat, and dancing.

reviews.name: Anjali R.
reviews.text: The precision is incredible. Every detail — the lashes, the highlight, the draping — was executed flawlessly. I keep looking at my wedding photos just to see her work.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: I was nervous about heavy makeup for my engagement shoot. She convinced me to trust the process — and the result was the most 'me' I've ever looked in photographs.

reviews.text: Professional, punctual, hygienic, and incredibly skilled. My party look was fresh at midnight. I can't recommend highly enough.
